claims: Assess and manage agitation/delirium (RASS +3, CAM-ICU positive) with nonpharmacologic measures and antipsychotic therapy as clinically indicated.
Monitor and manage hypotension (NIBP systolic 89 mmHg) with vasopressor support (phenylephrine infusion) and fluid resuscitation as needed.
Monitor and treat hyperglycemia (glucose 177-287 mg/dL) with insulin sliding scale.
Monitor renal function (creatinine 1.9-2.2 mg/dL, BUN 57-61 mg/dL) and avoid nephrotoxic agents.
Monitor and manage anemia (hemoglobin 8.9-9.3 g/dL) with transfusion as indicated.
Monitor coagulation status (INR 1.3-1.6, PTT 30.9-33.6 sec) and manage anticoagulation as needed.
Monitor electrolytes (sodium 130-136 mEq/L, potassium 4.0-4.3 mEq/L, magnesium 1.8-1.9 mg/dL, phosphate 4.5-5.6 mg/dL) and replace as needed.
Monitor and manage pain (pain level 9) with analgesics as needed.
Perform bed mobility and range of motion exercises to prevent deconditioning (bedfast, JH-HLM 2b).
Assess and manage skin integrity (Braden score low, moisture, friction/shear) with repositioning and skin care.
